units: <cite ref="Tosefta Uktsin 1:5">Tosef. Ukts. I, 5</cite> <he>מפני שהופכה בע׳</he> because he is used to turn it up with the shovel; <cite ref="Sukkah 14a:9">Succ. 14ᵃ</cite> <he>מפני שראויות להופכן בע׳</he>.

<cite ref="Sukkah 14a:9">Ib.</cite>; <cite ref="Yevamot 64a:9">Yeb. 64ᵃ</cite> <he>למה … כע׳ מה ע׳ זה מהפך וכ׳</he> why is the prayer of the righteous symbolized by a shovel (the root <he>עתר</he> being used for praying, v. <cite ref="P01538"><he>עֲתִירָה</he> II</cite>)? As the shovel turns the grain from place to place, so the prayer of the righteous turns the dispensations of the Lord from anger to mercy; <cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 10:5">Num. R. s. 10</cite> (with ref. to <he>ויעתר</he>, <cite ref="Judges 13:8">Jud. XIII, 8</cite>).
